scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic and Perron/Schur-complement proof for every admissible n,k. Exhaustive small-n spectral verification is supplementary; stochastic Markov-chain outbreaks and unindexed literature priority are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two equal complete communities, 1<=k<=n simple undirected unweighted cross edges, homogeneous deterministic SIS probability map with 0<d,beta<1; not finite Markov-chain persistence, heterogeneous/weighted networks, or empirical epidemiology.
title: Sharp bridge-placement thresholds for two-community SIS networks
